plans.title: Skill Plans
plans.deleteConfirm: Delete this plan? This can't be undone.
plans.emptyHint: Create a plan to start training toward a goal.
plans.yourEntriesEmpty: No entries yet. Add a skill below.
plans.currentQueueEmpty: No active in-game training queue cached.
plans.attributesCurrentNote: Your clone's current sheet; the lenses below only re-cost the plan.
plans.attributesImpossible: EVE reports attributes totalling {{total}}, but a character's base sheet always totals 99, so this one cannot be read. Estimates below use a default spread — check that this app can see your implants.
plans.remapCountTooltip: How many free attribute remaps the optimizer may use (you get one per year in-game).
plans.optimizeRemapsTooltip: Evaluates the plan's entries in their current order — it never reorders them. Grouping similar skills together first (e.g. with "Suggest reorder") tends to produce bigger savings.
plans.remapNoGain: No remap improves this plan in its current order — keeping current attributes. Try "Suggest reorder" to group similar skills first, then optimize again.
plans.remapNoneAvailable: This plan has 0 remaps to spend, so nothing was placed — raise "Remaps available" above and optimize again.
plans.boosterDetected: EVE reports your attributes with a +{{bonus}} cerebral accelerator already included. It has been taken back out of your base sheet and filled in here instead.
plans.boosterDetectedNoExpiry: EVE does not report when an accelerator runs out. Until you set an expiry above, this plan is costed as if you had none.
plans.importPaste: Paste an EFT fit or a skill plan (one "Skill Name Level" per line)
plans.importFileDrop: Drop a .emp or .xml file here, or
plans.importFileTooLarge: That file is too large to import.
plans.importFileReadFailed: Couldn't read that file — try picking it again.
plans.importFileDecompressFailed: Couldn't decompress that file — it may be corrupt.
plans.importFileUnsupportedFormat: That file isn't a plan export this app recognizes.
plans.importFileBrowserUnsupported: Your browser doesn't support decompressing this file — try updating it.
plans.importFileMalformedXml: That file's XML is malformed or truncated.
plans.importFileMultiPlanUnsupported: This looks like a multi-plan backup file, not a single plan.
plans.importEmpty: Nothing to import — paste some text and click Parse.
plans.dropBlocked: {{skill}} is a prerequisite of {{blocker}}, so it has to stay ahead of it. Nothing moved.
plans.markerAttributesModalHint: Set the attributes this remap should target. Every point spent on one attribute comes off another — a legal remap always totals {{total}}, {{min}}–{{max}} per attribute.
plans.markerAttributesOverBudget_one: {{count}} point over budget — lower another attribute first
plans.markerAttributesOverBudget_other: {{count}} points over budget — lower another attribute first
plans.markerAttributesOutOfRange: One or more attributes are outside {{min}}–{{max}}
plans.markersNoGain: Remapping at these markers doesn't save time — try moving them.
plans.markersAtEnd: Every remap marker sits at the end of the plan, so nothing follows it to remap for — drag a marker in front of the skills it should speed up.
plans.remapFromEveCooldown: From EVE: {{bonus}} bonus + yearly on cooldown until {{date}}
plans.queueCompletedNote_one: {{count}} skill finished training. Log in to EVE to apply it.
plans.queueCompletedNote_other: {{count}} skills finished training. Log in to EVE to apply them.
plans.queuePausedNote: Training is paused, so EVE reports no completion times.
plans.remapCapNote_one: Evaluated with {{count}} remap. This plan allows more; placement beyond that is not available yet.
plans.remapCapNote_other: Evaluated with {{count}} remaps. This plan allows more; placement beyond that is not available yet.
plans.headerBoosterTooltip: These times assume the booster you entered under Training, not one the game knows about. Until it expires they run faster than your in-game skill queue.

login.permissionsHint: Grants read-only access to your skills, assets, wallet, mail, calendar, contracts, market orders, industry, clones, player structure names, planetary colonies, contacts, loyalty points and notifications. EVE's consent screen lists the planetary scope as "manage your planetary installations" — NeoCom Desk only reads that data and never writes to it. pi.stalenessHint: ESI only recalculates a colony's data when it's opened in the EVE client.
pi.stalenessTooltip: Extractor expiry times are fixed at install and always accurate. Stored quantities and the last extraction cycle only update once you open the colony in the game client, so this app never shows those.
pi.lastUpdateTooltip: When CCP last recalculated this colony — only changes when the colony is opened in the EVE client.
pi.attentionUnknownTooltip: This colony's detail couldn't be loaded from ESI, so its status can't be shown with confidence. Try Refresh — if you revoked this app's planetary access, log in again.
pi.noOwnColoniesHint: Turn on "Show alt colonies" above to see your other characters' colonies.
pi.noPinsTitle: No pin data cached for this colony

yield.decayedTooltip: Every extractor here has fallen to under 35% of the output it managed in its first day. Extractor output decays from install, so a reset restores the opening rate — the Reset now column shows what a day of that is worth.

altColonies.notLoaded: Not loaded yet, so their colonies aren't listed: {{names}}. Switch to that character and refresh to cache them.

piPlan.spaceHint: Sets the starting customs rate only. It never changes yield — per-planet richness is scanner-only and is not in ESI.
piPlan.customsRateReset: Use the default for this space
piPlan.rateFromHighsecSkill: 10% highsec NPC base, less 1% per level of Customs Code Expertise — this character has level {{level}}. Any POCO owner tax is on top; edit the rate to add it.
piPlan.rateFromHighsecUnknown: 10% highsec NPC base, untrained. This character's skills haven't loaded, so Customs Code Expertise could not be applied — edit the rate if it is trained.
piPlan.rateFromPlayerPoco: Outside highsec a player POCO has no NPC component, so Customs Code Expertise does nothing and this starts at 0%. Set the owner's tax yourself.
piPlan.rateEdited: Your own rate. Reset it to go back to the default for this space.
piPlan.layoutHint: Customs is charged where goods cross a planet boundary, not where they change tier. Two tiers made on one planet pay nothing between them, which is why the layout can flip the sign of the margin.
piPlan.floorHint: What you buy off the market; everything above it you make. Buying P1 needs no extractors at all, so it is fully answerable with no colonies.
piPlan.customsBetweenTooltip: Both sides of every hop the layout puts a planet boundary on — export off one planet and import onto the next. Zero when every made tier shares a planet.
piPlan.totalCostTooltip: Bought inputs plus customs. It excludes what the chain cannot see: no POCO fuel, no hauling and no time.
piPlan.footprintTooltip: A character can run six planets at once, and one planet holds only so many pins. Planets, not ISK, are what runs out first — a floor that wins on margin while needing a colony you cannot build has not won.
piPlan.p0MarketNote: P0 you extract is valued at the hub, not at zero: extracting it costs a planet slot and forgoes a sale. The P0 floor's edge is the processing margin and customs it avoids, not free inputs.
piPlan.needsRateHint: Supplying your own P0 depends on a planet you may not have, and there is no published yield per planet. Enter what one extractor program sustains per hour and this floor is costed; leave it blank and it stays unanswered rather than guessed at zero.
piPlan.notPriceableTitle: No verdict: not priceable at this hub
piPlan.notPriceableHint: {{hub}} has no sell order for {{names}}. Without a price there is no honest margin, so none is shown.
piPlan.pricesFailedTitle: Hub prices could not be fetched
piPlan.pricesFailedHint: The planner needs live market prices. Check your connection, then refresh.
piPlan.loadFailedHint: Planetary schematics or market prices failed to load. Refresh to try again.
piPlan.readTooltip: What the hub says about this tier on its own: whether processing it is worth more than its inputs cost. Before customs, and independent of the floor you picked — the customs rate is what can flip the whole chain.
piPlan.sensitivityTitle: Margin by sourcing floor and customs rate
piPlan.sensitivityTableLabel: Margin per unit for each sourcing floor across customs rates
piPlan.sensitivityHint: Which floor wins is a function of the rate, not a fixed answer: at 0% supplying your own P0 wins, and from 10% up buying P1 does.
piPlan.planetsTaxedTooltip: How many planet boundaries the layout puts inside the chain. It is what the customs bill is charged over, not how many planets the whole operation occupies.
piPlan.outputRequiredHint: The plan is sized from how many units a day you want. Give it a positive number and the verdict comes back.

settings.fontScaleHint: Scales text and controls together. Applies immediately and stays on this device.

notifications.hint: Choose how you'd like to be told, and what about, per character. App sends a browser notification; List adds it to the Overview page. Stays on this device.
notifications.blockedNotice: Notifications are blocked — enable them in your browser's site settings, then return here.
notifications.installRequiredNotice: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work once NeoCom is installed to your home screen — Safari's Share menu, then "Add to Home Screen." Open it from there and come back to turn them on.
notifications.enableHint: This device hasn't granted notification permission yet.
notifications.emptyTitle: Add a character to configure notifications
notifications.reauthHint: This character hasn't granted the permission this notification needs. Re-authorize the character to enable it.
notifications.corpCapabilityHint: This character doesn't hold the in-game corporation role this notification needs. Re-authorizing won't fix it — a corp Director has to grant the role.
notifications.extractorExpiringHint: Delivered up to 72 hours ahead, even with the app closed, once installed and enabled for notifications — open the app at least that often to keep it current. The Planetary Industry page always shows the real expiry.
notifications.corpEventBestEffortHint: Best-effort: fires only while the app is open. Not a substitute for in-game alerts.
notifications.structureFuelLowThresholdLabel: Warn when fuel remaining drops below:
notifications.structureFuelLowNotDuplicateHint: This is separate from EVE's own low-fuel alert, which fires later at a fixed point — not a copy of it, an earlier warning of your choosing.
notifications.walletBalanceChangedThresholdLabel: Notify on changes of at least:
notifications.walletBalanceChangedThresholdHint: Accepts shorthand: 10.5m, 10,500,000, or 10500000 (b = billion, m = million, t = thousand).
notifications.browserChannelHint: Pop-ups from your operating system. Needs permission. Events with a known future time can arrive up to 72 hours ahead even with the app closed, once installed on iPhone and iPad; the rest need the app open.
notifications.feedChannelHint: A dismissible list on the Overview page. Works on every device.
notifications.eveTypesHint: This curated set of notifications, grouped by family below, defaults to the Overview list only, except the three structure-under-attack alerts, which also default to a browser notification — flip any type up or down per channel.

activityLog.title: Activity Log
activityLog.hint: Recent requests this device has made to EVE's servers — useful for your own reference, or for a support conversation. Clears on reload.
activityLog.emptyHint: Requests the app makes will appear here as you use it.

corp.title: Corporation
corp.dataAgeNote: EVE caches corporation data for about an hour, so anything due sooner than that may already have happened — check the game client before acting on a short timer.
corp.noAccessHint: This character's in-game corporation roles do not open any corp data. Settings has a Corp access row that explains what is needed.

detail.moonDecay: Moon chunk breaks up on its own

vitals.runwayHint: How long division {{division}} lasts: its own balance divided by its own average daily spending over the last {{days}} days. EVE publishes no all-divisions journal, so this covers that one wallet. Income is ignored, so this is what is already banked.

people.changeHint: Members who joined or left since this device last opened the Members page. It keeps saying so until you open it, which is what clears the count.

members.darkHint: Members with no login for {{days}} days or more. A member who joined and has never logged in counts from the day they joined.
members.emptyHint: EVE reported no tracking rows for this corporation.
members.noAccessHint: EVE only opens the member list and its last-login dates to a Director. No other corporation role can see them, and granting access here will not change that.

assets.title: Assets
assets.emptyHint: EVE reported no assets for this corporation.
assets.fetchTruncatedNotice: Only the first {{shown}} assets were fetched — this corporation has more.
assets.noAccessHint: EVE only opens the corporation asset list to a Director. No other corporation role can see it, and granting access here will not change that.

corp.grantPromptBody: You hold {{roles}} in {{corporation}}. Grant corp access so NeoCom Desk can show your corporation's data?
corp.grantPromptHint: Either way, Settings has a Corp access row whenever you want it.
corp.accessHint: Corp data needs two things: a corporation role, granted in game, and access to the corp endpoints, granted here. Roles are read from EVE and can only be changed in game.
corp.accessCharacterUnknown: Select a character to see its corp access.
corp.accessNoneHint: This character holds no corporation role that opens corp data, so granting access would unlock nothing.
corp.accessMissingHint: Corp data stays hidden until this character grants access.
corp.accessReadyHint: This character can see the corp data its roles allow.
